What are Fluxes?

An ordinary magnet sticks on one face and pushes away on the other. Fluxes stick on both. Every ring snaps to every other ring, whichever way you flip it, so they connect from every angle and behave in ways your hands do not expect.

That small surprise makes them a fidget that never gets old: smooth and calming to play with alone, and a game or a puzzle the moment someone else picks one up.

Questions

What are Fluxes?

Fluxes are magnetic rings that stick on both sides. An ordinary magnet sticks on one face and pushes away on the other, but every Flux snaps to every other Flux, whichever way you flip it. They connect from every angle, so you can build, stack, wear and play games with them.

Who are Fluxes for?
  • Kids 4 and upBuilding, stacking and color games.
  • Neurodivergent and autisticA calm, satisfying sensory fidget.
  • Adults at workA desk fidget for busy hands.
  • SeniorsSimple, tactile play for any age.
  • Therapy waiting roomsSomething to share while you wait.
How do people play with them?
Can you wear them?

Yes. Slip one on as a ring, or wear them as earrings. No ear piercing required.

What colors and styles are there?

Fluxes come in red, orange, yellow, green, light blue, dark blue, purple, pink, grey, white and black. Special styles include crystal, heat color changing, glow in the dark and UV blacklight. You can mix any of them in a custom 20-pack.

How does the custom 20-pack work?

Tap the colors you want in the 20-pack builder. The bar shows how much of your pack each color makes up. When you reach 20, add it to your cart. You can build as many packs as you like, and each one keeps its own colors through checkout.

Are Fluxes available for wholesale or licensing?

Yes. Fluxes are patent pending and available for licensing. For wholesale or licensing, email info@segalmagic.com.
